sources.title: Scalable agent alignment via reward modeling: a research direction — quoted full-text passages (arXiv 1811.07871v1 PDF)

state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors split the alignment problem into (1) learning a reward function from user feedback that captures the user's intentions and (2) training a policy with RL to optimise the learned reward function, separating the 'What?' from the 'How?'. They call this approach reward modeling.
title: Reward modeling: separate learning what to achieve from learning how to achieve it
